scenario.description: Nora is handling the final arrangements for her family's adoption of one of two rescue kittens and must decide which kitten to bring home, when to pick it up, where it will settle, and how its first-day care will work after checking in with the other family members.

shared_context.S1: The family has been approved to adopt one of two rescue kittens, Pippin or Juniper.
shared_context.S2: Nora is handling the final adoption arrangements and will make the final call about the kitten and the first-day plan.
shared_context.S3: The family has a spare study that can be used as a quiet settling-in room.
shared_context.S4: The rescue asks families to confirm the kitten, pickup timing, settling-in arrangement, and initial care plan before the adoption is finalized.
shared_context.S5: Before confirming anything, Nora routinely checks with each family member for circumstances or information that should shape the plan.

PF1.text: Eli's allergist told him that, between these two kittens, only Pippin's short coat is compatible with Eli's diagnosed cat allergy; Eli has not brought this up to the family yet.

PF2.text: The rescue coordinator told Sam that Pippin can be picked up on May 8, 2027, and should spend the first 72 hours in the spare study; this information has not reached the group yet.

PF3.text: Leah's work schedule means she can reliably give Pippin wet food at exactly 07:00 each morning, but she cannot take the evening feeding; she has not volunteered this schedule to Nora.

acceptance_conditions: Pippin must be selected because his coat is the only one compatible with Eli's allergy.
Pippin must be picked up on May 8, 2027.
Pippin must spend the first 72 hours in the spare study.
Leah must be assigned Pippin's morning wet-food feeding at exactly 07:00.

decisive_facts.why: Eli's allergist's specific compatibility finding changes the kitten selection from either kitten to Pippin, whose short coat is the only one compatible with Eli's allergy.
The rescue coordinator's exact May 8 pickup date and 72-hour spare-study instruction change both the pickup date and settling-in room.
Leah's exact work-compatible schedule changes the morning feeding assignment to Leah at 07:00.
